map.不能，FiO2 为经验估算，实际氧合以动脉血气与 SpO2 为准。: No, FiO2 is an empirical estimate; actual oxygenation should be judged by arterial blood gas and SpO2.
map.不能，鼻导管与面罩 FiO2 曲线不同，须按装置选择对应算法。: No, nasal cannulas and masks have different FiO2 curves, so the matching algorithm must be chosen for the device.
map.依据吸氧装置与氧流量换算吸入氧浓度 FiO2，便于护理人员设定给氧参数，保证患者: Convert the inspired oxygen concentration FiO2 from the oxygen delivery device and flow rate, which helps nursing staff set oxygen parameters and ensure the patient reaches an appropriate oxygenation level.

map.干冷气流伤黏膜，需加温湿化或换面罩，且 FiO2 不再线性升高。: Dry cold flow irritates the mucosa, so warming and humidification or a mask change is needed, and FiO2 no longer rises linearly.
map.文丘里面罩按标称 FiO2（24%/28%/35% 等）选择，核对流量刻度。: A Venturi mask is chosen by the nominal FiO2 (24% / 28% / 35% etc.); check the flow scale.

map.鼻导管 1–6 L/min 时按 FiO2≈21+4×流量 估算，超 6 L/m: For a nasal cannula at 1-6 L/min, estimate FiO2 ≈ 21 + 4 x flow; above 6 L/min, humidification and warming are needed.
